title: AIT Student Academic Transcript (AitTranscriptCredential), VCDM 1.1
description: The AIT Student Academic Transcript as a W3C Verifiable Credential, Data Model 1.1, JSON-LD (ldp_vc). It is the 1.1 counterpart of ait-transcript-credential.schema.json (Data Model 2.0), which is what the transcript demo issues today. Differences from the 2.0 schema: the base context is https://www.w3.org/2018/credentials/v1, the dates are issuanceDate and expirationDate, and there is no credentialStatus, because Inji Certify 0.14 attaches a status entry only to a 2.0 credential. The proof is one of two suites Certify 0.14 can emit: Ed25519Signature2020 (multibase proofValue) or Ed25519Signature2018 (detached JWS in proof.jws). credentialSubject is unchanged: all values are strings, because Certify fills a text template; dates are ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) and numbers are decimal strings. See ait-transcript-credential.v1_1.example.json and ait-transcript-credential.v1_1.jws.example.json.

@context.description: JSON-LD contexts: VCDM 1.1, then the AIT transcript vocabulary (terms under https://ait.example/transcript#). A credential signed with Ed25519Signature2020 adds that suite's context as a third entry; Ed25519Signature2018 needs none, because the 1.1 context defines it. The transcript context URL is internal to the demo stack.

id.description: Credential identifier: https://ait.example/credential/ followed by a UUID.

issuer.description: The AIT University Registrar's DID (did:key in the demo; its public key is the DID itself).

issuanceDate.description: Issuance time of this credential (UTC). Named validFrom in the 2.0 schema.

expirationDate.description: Expiry of this credential (UTC). Named validUntil in the 2.0 schema. The demo issuer sets two years after issuanceDate.

proof.description: Issuer signature over the credential, canonicalized with URDNA2015.

proofEd25519Signature2020.title: Ed25519Signature2020 (the suite the demo stack signs with today)

verificationMethod.description: Issuer DID URL of the signing key.
Issuer DID URL of the signing key.

jws.description: Detached JWS (RFC 7515 with RFC 7797 unencoded payload): <protected header>..<signature>. The header carries alg EdDSA and b64 false; the payload is omitted.

transcript.title: Transcript subject (the student and the degree)

id.description: The holder: the student's wallet key as a did:jwk (bound at issuance). Not a student number.

fullName.description: Student's full name as one string (not split into given, middle and family names), e.g. "Sila N Mahoot".

country.description: Student's country, as a name (not an ISO code), e.g. "Thailand".

registrationNo.description: AIT student number for this degree, e.g. "st125001". A student with two degrees has two numbers and two transcripts.

previousDegree.description: Previous degree and awarding institution, free text, e.g. "B.Eng Computer Engineering, Kasetsart University".

yearAwarded.description: Year the previous degree was awarded (YYYY).

dateAdmitted.description: Date admitted to AIT for this degree.

degreeAwarded.description: Degree name, e.g. "Master of Engineering", "Doctor of Philosophy".

faculty.description: School (faculty) name, e.g. "School of Engineering and Technology".

notes.description: Remarks on the transcript; "-" when there are none.

issueDate.description: Issue date printed on the transcript (the document's date, not the credential's issuanceDate).

courses.description: The course record, one entry per semester (term), in order. This is the structured source of the transcript's course table.

courseTableHtml.description: Presentation only: the course table pre-rendered as HTML for the PDF. Same content as courses plus the credit totals; not intended for mapping.

courseList.description: Presentation only: one line per course, "<title> — <grade>", lines separated by \n. Derived from courses.

programCommittee.description: Programme (thesis) committee members, one per line (lines separated by \n), chair first with "(Chair)".

cumGpa.description: Cumulative GPA at the end of this semester.
